# `browser-tab window set`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab window set [FLAGS] <windowId>`

Move/resize/minimize/foreground a window

## Arguments

### `<windowId>`

## Flags

### `--bounds <bounds>`

Global-coordinate frame x,y,w,h

### `--display <n>`

0-based display index (fills that monitor)

### `--state <state>`

normal|minimized|maximized|fullscreen

### `--focus`

Raise/foreground the window
